title: Iterated expectation on a finite product
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be finite types, and let $v:\alpha\times\beta\to\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $v$ over $\alpha\times\beta$ equals the iterated uniform average, first over $\beta$ and then over $\alpha$: $\mathbb E_{(a,b)\in\alpha\times\beta}v(a,b)=\mathbb E_{a\in\alpha}\,\mathbb E_{b\in\beta}v(a,b)$.
